function onLoad()
    --local pos = self.getPosition()
    --pos.y = pos.y + 1
    local params = {position = {-0.85,-0.045,1.9},
                label = 'Hide', font_size = 100,
                click_function = 'buttonClicked',
                function_owner = self,
                width = 500, height = 100}
    self.createButton(params)

    local btn_params = {
        function_owner = self,
        label = string.char(10008)
    }
    for i,color in ipairs(players) do
        btn_params.click_function = "toggle_hide_" .. color
        btn_params.color = color
        btn_params.tooltip = color
        btn_params.position = {-1.6875 + 0.375*i, -0.045, 1.6}
        self.createButton(btn_params)
    end
    self.attachInvisibleHider("",true,players)
end


--Common variables and tables
players = {"Pink", "Orange", "Green", "Blue", "White", "Red",
            "Yellow", "Purple"}
bdim = 0.2
b_pos = {
    {-1*bdim,5,1*bdim}, {0*bdim,5,1*bdim} ,{1*bdim,5,1*bdim},
    {-1*bdim,5,0*bdim}                    ,{1*bdim,5,0*bdim},
    {-1*bdim,5,-1*bdim},{0*bdim,5,-1*bdim},{1*bdim,5,-1*bdim}
}
btn_params = {
    function_owner = self
}


--Functions and buttons for the zone
function buttonClicked(obj, color, alt_click)
    if color == "Black" then
        local pos = self.getPosition()
        local scl = self.getScale()
        pos.y = pos.y + 2.2*scl.y/2
        local zoneSpawn = {position = pos
                , scale = { 2.5*scl.x, 2*scl.y, 2.5*scl.z }
                , type = 'ScriptingTrigger'
                , callback = 'zoneCallback'
                , callback_owner = self
                , rotation = self.getRotation() }
        spawnObject(zoneSpawn)
    end
end

function zoneCallback(zone)
  for _,obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
    local hidTo = "Hiding to "
    local hiderList = {}
    --obj.setInvisibleTo(players)
    btn_params.tooltip = "All"
    btn_params.color = "Black"
    btn_params.position = {0, 5, 0}
    btn_params.click_function = 'click_func_Black'
    obj.createButton(btn_params)
    for i,color in ipairs(players) do
        if toggleSwitches[players[i]] then
            btn_params.tooltip = players[i]
            btn_params.color = players[i]
            btn_params.position = b_pos[i]
            btn_params.click_function = 'click_func_' .. players[i]
            obj.createButton(btn_params)
            table.insert(hiderList, players[i])
            hidTo = hidTo .. "|" .. players[i]
        end
    end
    hiddenObjects[obj.guid] = hiderList
    obj.attachInvisibleHider("",true,hiddenObjects[obj.guid])
    broadcastToColor(hidTo, "Black", {1,1,1})
  end

  zone.destruct() --destroy the zone when you're done with it, to avoid clutter.
end


--Functions for the Toggles for player colors
hiddenObjects = {}
toggleSwitches = {
                Pink = true, 
                Orange = true, 
                Green = true, 
                Blue = true, 
                White = true, 
                Red = true,
                Yellow = true, 
                Purple = true
}

function find_button(color)
    buttons = self.getButtons()
    for id,o in ipairs(buttons) do
        if o.tooltip == color then
            return o.index  --I don't know why -1, but it works
        end
    end
end

function toggle_hide_Pink(obj, color, alt_click)
    if color == "Black" then
        toggleSwitches.Pink = not toggleSwitches.Pink
        buttonid = find_button("Pink")
        if toggleSwitches.Pink then
            self.editButton({index=buttonid, label=string.char(10008)})
        else
            self.editButton({index=buttonid, label=""})
        end
    end
end

--Functions to make object visible to one/all player
function remove_player(objGUID, player)
    newTable = {}
    for i,color in ipairs(hiddenObjects[objGUID]) do
        if color == player then
        else
            table.insert(newTable,color)
        end
    end
    hiddenObjects[objGUID] = newTable
end

function click_func_Black(obj, color, alt_click)
    if color == "Black" then
        obj.attachInvisibleHider("",false)
        local buttons = obj.getButtons()
        for i,o in ipairs(buttons) do
            if o.tooltip == "Pink" then
                obj.removeButton(o.index)
            elseif o.tooltip == "Orange" then
                obj.removeButton(o.index)
            elseif o.tooltip == "Green" then
                obj.removeButton(o.index)
            elseif o.tooltip == "Blue" then
                obj.removeButton(o.index)
            elseif o.tooltip == "White" then
                obj.removeButton(o.index)
            elseif o.tooltip == "Red" then
                obj.removeButton(o.index)
            elseif o.tooltip == "Yellow" then
                obj.removeButton(o.index)
            elseif o.tooltip == "Purple" then
                obj.removeButton(o.index)
            elseif o.tooltip == "All" then
                obj.removeButton(o.index)
            end
            hiddenObjects[obj.guid] = {}
        end
    end
end
function click_func_Pink(obj, color, alt_click)
    if color == "Black" then
        remove_player(obj.guid, "Pink")
        obj.attachInvisibleHider("",true,hiddenObjects[obj.guid])
        local buttons = obj.getButtons()
        for i,o in ipairs(obj.getButtons()) do
            if o.tooltip == "Pink" then

            end

    end
end
